findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: personal_visa_assessment · Private data: spain_visa_requirements, personal_visa_assessment, request_consultation · Public sink: personal_visa_assessment, request_consultation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: personal_visa_assessment · Private data: spain_visa_requirements, personal_visa_assessment, request_consultation · Public sink: personal_visa_assessment, request_consultation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
